name: tableau-card-engine
description: Tableau Card Engine (TCE) -- a modular game engine for building single-player tableau card games using Phaser 4 RC and TypeScript
author: TheWizardsCode

scripts.monte-carlo: tsx scripts/monte-carlo.ts --seeds 200 --seed-prefix mc-balance --maxTurns 25 --strategy greedy --out results/main-street-monte-carlo.json --csv-out results/main-street-monte-carlo.csv
scripts.start:electron: npm run build:electron && npm run build:electron-main && electron .
scripts.package: npm run build:electron && npm run build:electron-main && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run build:electron && npm run build:electron-main && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.package:linux: npm run build:electron && npm run build:electron-main && electron-builder --linux --publish never
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:electron && npm run build:electron-main && electron-builder --mac --publish never
